Use a dedicated homepage_category_rows relation rather than overloading HomepageBlock text fields.

Owner must run the documented non-destructive persistent MySQL import/admin review and provide exact imported/active totals for Phase 6A Chunk 3.

Owner must verify controlled staging transactional email delivery, SPF/DKIM/DMARC status and HTML/plain-text rendering without sharing credentials.
Owner runtime must run the non-destructive Phase 10 Chunk 1 migration plus focused/full tests because PHP and Composer are unavailable in Arena.
Owner runtime must run focused refund and full regression tests before the paid-cancellation admin fix is accepted; no additional real/test refund should be submitted for qualification.
Owner confirmed rythm.test now resolves to the rhythm_db MySQL database and cached configuration was cleared.
Owner reported all Phase 10 qualification gates complete at 4a6c498; no returns/tax values or legal enablement was activated.
Owner-side Phase 11 responsive/conversion UAT and isolated MySQL qualification remain required before Phase 11 completion.
